$comment: The four festival events, in journey order (SFC -> Under the Stars -> Educational Screening -> Main Screening). `id` is used in films/schedule; `theme` is the colour theme (sfc | uts | main | base). `title` lines + `script` build the big display title. Media keys refer to media.json.

items.name: Short Film Competition
title: Short Film
Competition
items.tagline: New voices, short stories, one night.
items.summary: Showcases emerging Indonesian filmmakers, highlighting original stories and fresh creative voices. Finalists screen on the night and winners are announced live.
description: The Short Film Competition opens the festival journey. Every year we call for short films from students, first-time directors and independent filmmakers across Indonesia and Australia.
Finalists screen in front of a live audience and an industry jury. Awards include Best Short Film, Best Director and the Audience Choice Award, voted on the night.
Submission details for the 21st edition will be announced soon.

items.name: Under the Stars
title: Under
Stars
items.tagline: Indonesian cinema, open-air, under the Melbourne sky.
items.summary: An open-air screening of featured Indonesian films in a community-driven outdoor setting. Bring a blanket.
description: Under the Stars takes Indonesian cinema outdoors: a featured film screened open-air, with the community gathered on blankets and picnic rugs.
Come early for food, music and catching up with friends before the film starts at sunset.
Venue and full details for the 21st edition will be announced soon.

items.name: Educational Screening
title: Educational
Screening
items.tagline: Films and learning for students and young audiences.
items.summary: A special screening designed for students and young audiences, offering curated films and learning opportunities that explore Indonesian culture and storytelling.
description: The Educational Screening brings Indonesian cinema to students and young audiences, with a curated film chosen for discussion in the classroom and beyond.
Each session includes a guided conversation about the film's culture, language and storytelling. Teachers can request discussion notes in advance.
Schools and groups interested in attending can contact us. Full details for the 21st edition will be announced soon.

items.name: Main Screening
title: Main
Screening
items.tagline: Three days of Indonesian cinema at ACMI.
items.summary: The heart of the festival: three curated Indonesian films that represent the festival's essence, with panels and Q&As at ACMI.
description: The Main Screening is the festival's flagship weekend at ACMI: three curated Indonesian features that represent the essence of the festival, many screening in Australia for the first time.
Between screenings, join panels and Q&As with directors, actors and producers. All films screen with English subtitles.
